name: Frühstückspension & Ferienwohnungen Hattenhof
beschreibung:
Surrounded by green meadows and panoramic vistas of the Kaiser mountains, Hattenhof in Schwoich provides lovely rooms and spacious holiday flats. It makes an ideal base for families and nature lovers.

Swimming lakes, cycling paths, and the fortress town of Kufstein are just a short drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Fruehstueckspension & Ferienwohnungen Hattenhof in Schwoich offers countryside charm in Kufsteinerland.
